question: Ngozi Okonjo Iweala of _______ has been appointed as first female chief of WTO in Feb, 2021. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Ghana
South Africa
Nigeria
Kenya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nigeria

Explanation:
In February 2021, Nigeria's Ngozi Okonjo Iweala was appointed as the first female Director-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO). She is the first woman and the first African to hold this position. She previously served as Nigeria's Finance Minister and Foreign Minister. Her term began on March 1, 2021. The WTO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. This appointment was seen as a major step for women leadership in international trade.

question: The total number of ministers, including the Chief Minister, in the council of ministers in a state CANNOT exceed ______ of the total number of members of the legislative assembly of that State. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: \(\frac{1}{{20}}\)
\(\frac{1}{{10}}\)
3%
15%
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 15%

Explanation:
According to Article 164(1A) of the Indian Constitution, the total number of ministers, including the Chief Minister, in the council of ministers of a state cannot exceed 15% of the total number of members of the legislative assembly of that state. This provision was added by the 91st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003. The objective was to limit the size of the council of ministers to improve government efficiency and prevent misuse of resources. However, the minimum number of ministers in any state is 12. This rule does not apply to states under President's rule.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which constitutional amendment fixed the size of the council of ministers? → 91st Amendment, 2003
☛ Under which article is the size of the council of ministers mentioned? → Article 164(1A)
☛ What is the minimum number of ministers in a state? → 12
☛ On which states does the 15% limit not apply? → States under President's rule
☛ Was there any limit on the size of the council of ministers before 2003? → No
question_hi: किसी राज्य में मंत्रिपरिषद में मुख्यमंत्री सहित मंत्रियों की कुल संख्या उस राज्य की विधानसभा के कुल सदस्यों की संख्या के ______ से अधिक नहीं हो सकती। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: \(\frac{1}{{20}}\)
\(\frac{1}{{10}}\)
3%
15%
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 15%

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 164(1A) के अनुसार, किसी राज्य के मंत्रिपरिषद में मुख्यमंत्री सहित मंत्रियों की कुल संख्या, उस राज्य की विधान सभा के कुल सदस्यों की संख्या के 15% से अधिक नहीं हो सकती। यह प्रावधान 91वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2003 द्वारा जोड़ा गया था। इसका उद्देश्य मंत्रिपरिषद के आकार को सीमित करके सरकार की दक्षता बढ़ाना और संसाधनों के दुरुपयोग को रोकना था। हालांकि, किसी भी राज्य में मंत्रियों की न्यूनतम संख्या 12 होनी चाहिए। यह नियम राष्ट्रपति शासन वाले राज्यों पर लागू नहीं होता।

question: Select the option that shows the correct match of an organisation and its headquarters. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 1)

question: Which one of the following is a member of BRICS? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Canada
Bhutan
Indonesia
Brazil
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Brazil

Explanation:
BRICS is an international organization comprising five major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa. The name is an acronym formed from the first letters of these countries. BRICS was established in 2009 and aims to promote economic cooperation, trade, and investment among member nations. Canada and Bhutan are not members of this group. Indonesia is also not a BRICS member, although it is an emerging economy. The headquarters of BRICS is located in Shanghai, China, and it works towards reforming global economic governance.

question: In which state of India is Namdroling Monastery located? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Himachal Pradesh
Karnataka
Andhra Pradesh
Sikkim
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Karnataka

Explanation:
Namdroling Monastery, also known as the Golden Temple, is located in Bylakuppe, Mysore district of Karnataka, India. It belongs to the Nyingma sect of Tibetan Buddhism and was established in 1963 by Pema Norbu Rinpoche. The monastery houses approximately 5,000 monks and nuns, making it the largest Tibetan Buddhist teaching center in India. It is renowned for its magnificent golden statues and vibrant murals. This site is a major attraction for tourists and pilgrims.

question: In which year was the Liberalized Exchange Rate Management System (LERMS) instituted in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1986
1992
2001
2005
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1992

Explanation:
The Liberalized Exchange Rate Management System (LERMS) was instituted in India in 1992. Introduced by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), it allowed partial market determination of the exchange rate. Under LERMS, 40% of foreign exchange earnings were sold at the market rate, while the remaining 60% was sold at the official rate. This system was part of the economic reforms following the 1991 balance of payments crisis. Later, in 1993, India adopted a unified exchange rate system, making the rupee fully convertible. LERMS played a crucial role in integrating India into the global economy.
